live.method: Every call Alladin publishes is written to an append-only ledger and never edited afterwards. A call fills only if price actually traded into the published entry zone within 2 sessions; otherwise it is marked no-fill and excluded from returns. Once filled it is held up to 5 sessions and exits on the real session low breaching the stop, the real session high reaching Target 1, or the close at the end of the window. Returns are measured from the fill against the originally published levels. Costs, slippage and taxes are not modelled.

performance.assumptions: Backtest, not a live track record. The same rule engine was replayed over 306 sessions of real Yahoo Finance history across a 26-name universe. A setup counts only if price actually traded into the entry zone within two sessions; it exits on the real low breaching the stop, the real high reaching Target 1, or the close after 5 sessions. Sizing assumes ~4% of capital per call. No costs, slippage, taxes or borrowing are modelled, and the universe is fixed today, so it carries survivorship bias. Past behaviour does not predict future results.
